Isha (sec): Heads up - nightly base-image canary started failing signing right after the rotation dry-run. Putting notes here so infra + runtime can sync.
Theo (eng-infra): looking. We applied a tighter IAM filter during the dry-run and the dry-run step cleaned up bindings marked "legacy". Might have removed the build SA binding by accident.
Maya (eng-runtime): what's the client error?
Isha (sec): cosign failing with: ```cosign: upload failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = request missing permission kms.cryptoKeys.encrypt```
kms-audit-bot: [automated] 2 KMS_PERMISSION_DENIED events for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/sign-v3. Callers: image-builder-sa, canary-runner. First seen 1718203205.
Theo (eng-infra): audit diff shows removed block for serviceAccount:image-builder-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. That was part of the dry-run cleanup.
Luca (sre): quick mitigation: reapply key-scoped encrypter role to image-builder-sa and gate it with an IAM condition restricting `resource.name` to the signing key and add a comment "temp-until=2024-05-12T06:00:00Z". We should avoid broad project-level grants.
Theo (eng-infra): I can apply that now. Note: our infra toolchain doesn't yet support automated TTL revokes, so I'll add a PR note and a manual revoke TODO.
Maya (eng-runtime): once you restore, i'll run a signed canary with `--annotations canary=true` and verify the runtime only promotes if signature present. Also I will add a CI preflight step `verify_kms_binding.sh` to fail early.
Isha (sec): please forward the IAM delta and the KMS denies to SIEM and tag compliance. We need retention for the temporary grant.
kms-audit-bot: [automated] forwarded IAM delta + 2 deny events to siem index=security at 1718203450.
Theo (eng-infra): applied scoped binding at 1718203468. PR comment: "emergency temp grant to restore canary; follow-up: add dry-run unit tests + automated revoke."
Maya (eng-runtime): canary signed successfully: `cosign: signature upload OK`. Pushing runtime guard to treat canary annotations specially.
Luca (sre): I'll create an alert rule: if KMS.PERMISSION_DENIED > 1 within 20m -> post to #eng-security and create an incident stub.
Isha (sec): follow-ups: 1) add dry-run safety checks to rotation script (no cleanup of bindings unless explicit approve), 2) add CI preflight to check key bindings, 3) create ticket for ephemeral grant automation (short-lived key access), 4) update signing runbook to include emergency grant approvers and revoke procedure.
Theo (eng-infra): opening PRs for dry-run safety + preflight. Will link here when ready.
Isha (sec): thanks all. No customer impact. Closing when PRs merged and revoke done. :white_check_mark:
